key_highlights: Hotter-than-expected domestic CPI data triggered an ASX sell-off as markets sharply repriced RBA rate cut expectations.
Consumer discretionary sector faces severe margin compression, highlighted by Harvey Norman's plunging profits amid reduced household spending.
Resources sector showed relative resilience, buoyed by gold, copper, and critical minerals exploration momentum.
AUD showed signs of life as widening interest rate differentials support the currency following the inflation shock.

sectors.trend: Sharp contraction in earnings driven by cost-of-living pressures and retrenchment in big-ticket retail spending.
sectors.implications: Multiple compression and risk of further earnings downgrades across retail and household goods stocks.

sectors.trend: Selective outperformance across precious, base, and critical minerals amid broader equity volatility.
sectors.implications: Capital reallocation toward junior explorers and gold/copper producers acting as portfolio stabilisers.

sectors.trend: Margin tailwinds from higher-for-longer rates counterbalanced by rising recession risks and mortgage stress.
sectors.implications: Range-bound performance for major banks as credit growth slows and bad-debt provisions face upward risk.

sectors.trend: Policy shifts on private health insurance rebates alongside targeted biotech pipeline developments.
sectors.implications: Defensive demand supports core healthcare providers, while small-cap biotech remains event-driven.

sectors.trend: Heightened valuation sensitivity to domestic yield pressure and offshore mega-cap tech swings.
sectors.implications: Elevated downside beta across high-multiple tech names in an elevated interest rate regime.

key_themes: Persistent inflation delaying RBA monetary easing cycle
Household balance sheet retrenchment impacting discretionary retailers
Resource sector resilience supported by gold and critical metals discovery
Stagflationary headwind as growth decelerates against sticky price pressures

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Hawkish RBA Policy and Sticky Inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to highly leveraged equities; favor cash, floating-rate debt, and inflation-hedged assets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Australian Consumer Spending Contraction and Recession
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight cyclical retail; reallocate into defensive consumer staples and essential services.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Tech Volatility and Capital Outflows
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge broad index exposure with selective put options or low-beta defensive equity holdings.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper producers as inflation and currency hedges.
opportunities.rationale: Sustained high domestic inflation and exploration success provide earnings resilience.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on AUD appreciation driven by hawkish rate differentials.
opportunities.rationale: RBA delayed easing contrasts with peer central banks, providing near-term support for AUD/USD.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight discretionary retail exposed to big-ticket consumer goods.
defensive_moves.rationale: Harvey Norman profit slump confirms accelerating margin compression and consumer distress.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement broad index downside protection across ASX benchmarks.
defensive_moves.rationale: Stagflation risks and repriced bond yields threaten aggregate equity valuation multiples.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish to neutral; ASX 200 likely to consolidate lower as rate cut hopes vanish and consumer earnings deteriorate.
market_outlook.long_term: Selective accumulation phase; structural support for resource exporters once terminal cash rates stabilize.
key_catalysts: Upcoming RBA Board cash rate decision and monetary policy statement
Quarterly Australian CPI and retail trade figures
Commodity price trajectory across iron ore, copper, and gold
Domestic corporate earnings updates reflecting consumer belt-tightening
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate behavior near 0.6500-0.6650 resistance
Performance spread between ASX 200 Discretionary (XDJ) and Materials (XMJ)
